areaSearches.blurb: You can apply to rent any available land and water area for various temporary uses.
areaSearches.heading: Area rental
areaSearches.label: Rent an area

landingPage.heading: Apply for a land area lease
landingPage.introduction: The City of Helsinki offers vacant land or water areas for rent for various types of activities. Choose your intended use.

commercialUses.blurb: You can rent a common area of the city for short-term sales activities, rent your shopfront for demonstration and sales activities, or enter into an agreement for food truck activities. You can rent the city's advertising spots on bridges for short-term advertising and communications.
commercialUses.label: Commercial and advertising spots

dogs.blurb: Koirankoulutuskentiltä voi vuokrata vakioviikkovuoron koirien koulutukseen.

gardening.blurb: Yhdistykset ja yhteisöt voivat vuokrata kaupungilta maa-alaa pienimuotoista kaupunkiviljelyä varten.

otherConstruction.blurb: You can rent a street or park area as a temporary work area for activities such as construction, lifting, property renovation, moving house, snow removal, or a film or TV production. You need to do this if you want to place equipment such as scaffolding, a hoist, a skip or a shipping container in the area. Notify the city if you are going to excavate in a street or park area.
otherConstruction.label: Work carried out on streets and in parks

outdoorEvent.blurb: You need a permit to organize an event on a street, square or park if the event restricts the public use of the area.
outdoorEvent.label: Organizing an outdoor event

permanentFixtures.blurb: You will need to make a placement agreement with the city if you want to place permanent structures, such as cable connections, access routes, underground building foundations or fences, on the street or in a park.
permanentFixtures.label: Placement of permanent structures in street or park areas

terraceOrParklet.blurb: Setting up an outdoor serving area for a restaurant or café requires a terrace permit if the terrace is set up in a public street or park area. Setting up a glazed street terrace also requires a building permit.
terraceOrParklet.label: Terraces and parklets
